source.filter: CIRAWFilter fallback (FlashRawImageFactory unavailable in test host)

notes: Single run, 9504x6336, unified memory, macOS 27 arm64.
Full-frame factor/restore alone saves only ~15% because the 60 MP materialize remains.
Window-local factor + pointwise restore is byte-exact and removes the 60 MP materialize: first window ~75 ms texture / ~115 ms clarity, amount changes ~43-50 ms.
Clarity factor depends on the texture band output; changing texture amount invalidates the clarity factor.
next: Implement a factor-texture cache keyed by source generation, band, radius and window+halo; use applyBandWindow for 1:1 preview. Keep the full-frame path for export until the masked-composite gate is re-run.

renderer_integration.status: not enabled; window-local factor differs from full factor by 1 ULP on this fixture
renderer_integration.next: fixed-origin tile factor shared by whole and window; full-frame factor is the strict fallback

strict_full_factor.requirements: full-frame factor for both frames; materialize the texture band before deriving the clarity factor
strict_full_factor.status: QA only; both-band first frame is slower, single-band first frame is near inline and amount changes are restore-only

tiled_output.policy: single-band 1:1 default; both-band falls back to the inline path
tiled_output.tradeoff: whole 1:1 recomputes all tiles (about 2.9x inline at 60 MP); window is 4.6x faster and amount changes reuse factor tiles

tiled_verification.conclusion: byte-exact but no performance win on the shipped window; default reverted to inline
